summary: Round 1 founder brief: backend and frontend testing. Backend: the full suite passes, 132/132. That includes 7 new edge tests in test_iter20_runs_layout_edges.py: stale rev returns 409; cancelling a queued run gives 'stopped' with a saved message; runs are isolated per visitor; layout validation and per-project scoping; override_reason still returns 422 on an unconfirmed plan; a solo project can issue. One existing test was flaky because of login lockout pollution. I fixed that test. Frontend: most items were verified in the UI. Graph opens by default. There is no Synthetic badge. The overflow menu contains only 'Reset this example'. There are no Highlight/Show changes buttons. The composer floats with a transparent band and clears on send. Stop shows 'Stopped. Nothing was changed.' and it persists after reload. Card drag persists after reload. Pan is clamped at ±120px. Clicking a card opens the inspector. Link handle → menu → 'Related to' draws a dashed edge that persists. The AI-off Draft plan flow works. Chat advance replied 'Drafted v1 … Checker: pass … Private review links prepared … Nothing was sent'. Chat intake saved job details, and the correction 'Actually 3 weeks' updated weeks to 3. Calendar: label, month/week toggle, Today, prev/next, one weekly bar per firm, grouped deadlines ('4 sites due · S01, S02, S03, S04'), and no Unscheduled section. The report-rules footer is shown. PDF page squares are shown. A solo-project quote was issued. Customer page: the gate copy is correct, and Ask, Draft change and 'Review and send as change request' prefilled the note. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow, and the schedule shows as a stacked list. A 409 stale rev is retried automatically ([409, 200]). Main problems found: (1) the tool-sheet Close (X) button is covered by the sticky header in every tool sheet, so it cannot be clicked. On mobile the sheet is full width, so a touch user cannot close it. (2) The graph link menu opens behind the floating composer when the cards are near the bottom. (3) The primary action stays 'Send for review' after the private link is created; it only becomes 'Awaiting' after the link is marked shared. (4) The quote sheet has no UI entry point until every firm has confirmed, so the quote-support-blocked view cannot be reached from the UI.

minor.issue: The advance reply ends with 'Nothing was sent: share them from Prepare review'. 'Prepare review' was removed. The label is now 'Send for review'.

ui_bugs.issue: The shadcn Sheet Close (X) button (absolute right-4 top-4, no z-index) is covered by the sticky header div (sticky top-0 z-10, bg white/95) in ToolSheet.jsx. elementFromPoint at the X returns the SheetTitle h2 on desktop 1920, at 960x400 and on mobile 390. The X is invisible and cannot be clicked. On mobile the sheet is w-full, so there is no overlay to tap either; only Escape closes it, which touch users do not have. Fix: give the Close z-20, or add an explicit close button inside the sticky header.

graph-link-menu is placed at the drop point inside the transformed canvas (z-40 within the graph stacking context). When the target card is near the bottom, the menu opens downwards under the floating composer overlay (z-20 sibling layer). 'Produces output for' and 'Related to' are hidden and intercepted, and a Playwright click timed out. The menu should flip upwards when near the bottom, or be portaled above the composer.
link-handle-* is opacity-0 until hover (group-hover). On touch devices it never becomes visible, so linking is impossible on mobile and tablet.

integration_issues.flow: Primary action: Send for review -> Awaiting <firm>
integration_issues.issue: After partner-card-create-link-* ('Private link created. It is not sent until you share it.'), the partner status is link_not_shared. primaryAction() maps that to 'Send for review', so the label does NOT become 'Awaiting Oak'. The same happens after chat advance (3 firms show 'Link not shared', primary = 'Send for review'). It only flips to Awaiting after mark-shared. This does not match the brief's 'after preparing link, label becomes Awaiting <firm>'. Decide which behaviour is intended and align the copy.

The quote sheet only opens through primary-action when no partner is waiting, and nothing else calls setTool('quote'). So on the 12-branch plan with firms that have not responded, the organizer cannot open the Customer quote sheet. quote-support / quote-support-blocked can only be rendered in edge cases. The backend gate (422 even with override_reason) is verified. If the blocked preview is meant to be visible, add an entry point (for example in the Inspector or the ⋯ menu).

stale() and load() refresh only the sheet. useItems loads /project/items only on mount (the load deps do not include rev). After another tab adds a task, the auto-retry works ([409, 200]) but tab 1's graph still shows no new task, even though the AI answer mentions it. The item list goes stale until a full page reload. Refetch items when rev changes or on stale().

issues: The very first run on an idle project shows 'Waiting for the previous request…' (status queued) even though there is no previous request. Use neutral copy such as 'Starting…' unless another run is actually active.

Partner chips default to unselected while own crew defaults to selected. On the examples (own capacity 0), 'Draft and check' fails with 'Choose at least one crew' until the user picks firms. Consider preselecting firms with capacity.
The copy 'No partners yet. Add them in Check.' refers to the removed 'Check' step; it should point to Job details.
The Plan frame count says '5 packages' but includes firms that are 'Not in plan'.
A dragged card can sit on top of and hide other cards (e.g. Alder dragged +200,+50 covered 'Unassigned sites'). There is no 'reset layout' option.
On mobile 390 the zoom controls overlap the frame count label ('6 package…' is clipped).
On mobile 390 the header takes 216px of 844 because the ⋯ button wraps onto its own row.

At 960x400 the graph area is only about 200px tall, and the composer plus suggestions cover most of it. It is usable, and Close/inspector are reachable, but cramped. The pencil icon floats away from the wrapped title.
Native date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) and native selects are used instead of the shadcn Calendar/Select components.
After the quote is issued on a partner-less project, the status still reads 'plan v1 selected for review'.

action_items: HIGH: Make the ToolSheet close button clickable and visible: z-index above the sticky header, or an explicit close button in the header. This matters most on mobile, where the full-width sheet otherwise cannot be closed by touch.
MEDIUM: Graph link menu: flip it upwards or portal it above the composer overlay so all 4 options can be clicked near the bottom edge.

MEDIUM: Decide whether primary-action should read 'Awaiting <firm>' once a private link is prepared (link_not_shared), as the brief says, or only after it is shared. Align primaryAction() and the copy.
MEDIUM: Refetch /project/items when rev changes or after stale()/load(), so the graph is not stale after a 409 reload.
LOW: Give the organizer an entry point to the Customer quote sheet while firms are unconfirmed, so the quote-support-blocked view is reachable (or drop it if this is intended).
LOW: Fix stale copy: 'share them from Prepare review' (advance reply) and 'Add them in Check.' (DraftTask).
LOW: Queued copy for the first run; preselect partner chips; make the link handle visible on touch; tidy the mobile header.
critical_code_review_comments: ToolSheet.jsx: the sticky header (z-10) is rendered inside SheetContent before the Radix Close, which has no z-index, so the header covers the Close button.
useItems.js: load() is only triggered on mount. Item state is not resynced on external rev changes. Composer relies on onAdopt(batch) for its own changes only.

GraphView.jsx: the link menu is positioned without viewport-aware flipping. NO_PAN excludes [data-movable], so panning only starts from truly empty space; this works but leaves little pannable area when frames fill the view.
Composer.jsx: the polling effect re-creates its interval on every runs change. Polls for multiple runs run sequentially in one tick. This is fine at the current scale.
ProjectSheet.jsx primaryAction(): 'declined' and 'expired' are in WAITING, so a declined firm leaves the button as 'Awaiting X' with no path forward except a redraft.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/make_quote_token.py (new helper, prints an issued quote path for UI testing)
/app/backend/tests/test_stage123_security.py (test_same_origin_ok now uses a random email; the fixed email was hitting the 5-failure lockout and returning 429 on repeat runs)

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (core flows pass; 1 high and 3 medium issues)

seed_data_creation: Only TEST_* projects inside isolated demo visitor sandboxes (fresh visitor_id per browser session or test), plus solo quote projects from the tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation run is a fresh visitor sandbox, so log in with signin-demo-organizer-button every time. The Job details sheet opens on the 'Paste a brief' tab; click intake-tab-form first. Partner fields sit in a collapsed accordion; click intake-partner-toggle-*. Draft plan: partner chips (draft-include-p-*) default off and own crew (draft-include-own) defaults on. Clicking own crew toggles it off. The Customer quote sheet is only reachable when primary-action = 'Customer quote' (a partner-less project with an own-crew plan). Use backend/tests/make_quote_token.py to get a /quote/<token> path for buyer@example.test; the code is shown on screen. To close tool sheets, use Escape, because the X is covered. The graph link menu near the bottom is covered by the composer; click it via JS. Round 2 items were not tested.
rca of the issue: Tool-sheet close: in ToolSheet.jsx the SheetContent children start with <div class='sticky top-0 z-10 ...'>, and shadcn's SheetPrimitive.Close is position:absolute with no z-index, so the sticky z-10 layer paints over it. Reproduce: open any tool sheet and call document.elementFromPoint at the X centre; it returns the h2. Mitigation: add 'z-20' to the Close in components/ui/sheet.jsx, or render a close button inside the sticky header. Link menu: it is rendered inside the graph's transformed container, which sits under the composer overlay layer (absolute z-20 sibling). Mitigation: compute whether the menu fits below and flip upwards, or render it via a portal with a higher z-index.
